lines: Part twelve asked which relations a task still uses. Part thirteen watches an observer read one position, update, and come back. A reading changes what the observer knows, and what it knows decides what must be kept.
第十二部问的是任务仍在使用哪些关系。第十三部看一个观察者读取一个位置、更新、再回到原处。读取改变观察者知道的东西，而它知道什么，决定了必须保留什么。
Coming back to the same place is not the same as coming back to the same knowledge.
回到同一个位置，并不等于回到同一份知识。
The Auric FIB atom pyramid, part thirteen: how an observation update exposes hidden relations.
Auric FIB 原子金字塔，第十三部：观察更新如何暴露隐藏关系。
Conditional slices, a four-corner tilt, and returns that keep teaching.
条件切面、四角倾斜，以及不断带来新知识的返回。

A pyramid point records three means: low, high and middle. The joint chance kappa of low with high is left free, anywhere from the larger of zero and X plus Y plus Z minus one, up to the smaller of X and Y.
金字塔上的一个点记录三个均值：低端、高端与中间。低端与高端同时出现的概率 kappa 没有被确定，可以取从零与 X+Y+Z−1 中较大者，到 X 与 Y 中较小者之间的任何值。
So a pyramid point is a summary of readings, not the whole source the observer holds.
所以金字塔上的点只是读数的摘要，而不是观察者手里的完整来源。
Now read the low position. If it is occupied, the middle must be empty, and the high mean becomes kappa over X. If it is empty, the high mean becomes Y minus kappa, over one minus X.
现在读取低端位置。若它被占，中间必定为空，高端均值变为 kappa 除以 X；若它为空，高端均值变为 Y 减 kappa，再除以 1 减 X。
Take two sources with the same three means: empty with joint, and low with high, half each. Reading low gives the same odds, yet after a one, the first is surely joint and the second surely low.
取两个三均值相同的来源：空与联合各占一半，低与高各占一半。读取低端给出相同的结果概率；可是读到一以后，前者必定是联合，后者必定是低端。
Which summaries survive an update? Keep a space of functions. Their means after any result can be recovered exactly when multiplying by the reading's likelihood stays inside that space.
哪些摘要能挺过一次更新？保留一个函数空间。当且仅当乘上读口的似然后仍留在这个空间里，结果之后这些函数的均值才能被精确恢复。
Reading the middle keeps one, x, y and z closed. Reading low and then predicting high needs the product x y, and with it the space already holds every function on the five patterns.
只读中间位置时，1、x、y、z 保持闭合。读取低端再预测高端，就需要乘积 xy；加上它，这个空间已经包含五种模式上的全部函数。
A product of activities balances the four square corners: empty times joint equals low times high. After a reading, this balance survives only if the likelihood is balanced in the same way.
活动权乘积模型让正方形四角保持平衡：空乘联合等于低乘高。一次读取之后，只有当似然也以同样方式平衡时，这个平衡才能保持。

Even a reading with no joint term can tilt it. Start uniform and accept with chance one plus x plus y, over three. The acceptance chance is three fifths, and the corner balance moves to minus one over eighty-one.
即使读口本身没有联合项，也能让它倾斜。从均匀律出发，以 (1+x+y)/3 的概率接受：接受的概率是五分之三，而四角平衡移到负八十一分之一。
Total covariance splits into the average covariance within each result, plus the spread of the result means.
总协方差分解为各结果内部协方差的平均，加上各结果均值之间的离散。
Reading low makes that spread a single direction, rank one. Observation turns part of the uncertainty into separation between outcomes, without promising that every variance falls.
读取低端时，这部分离散只有一个方向，秩为一。观察把一部分内部不确定性转成了结果之间的分离，但并不保证每个方差都下降。
Now follow the observer's history. Updating on a history multiplies the weight of each hidden parameter by its likelihood.
现在跟随观察者的历史。按一段历史更新，就是把每个隐藏参数的权重乘上它的似然。

The posterior is unchanged exactly when that likelihood is the same for every parameter. A controller back at the same node has returned in control flow; the observer has returned in knowledge only if the history taught nothing.
当且仅当该似然对每个参数都相同，后验才保持不变。控制器回到同一个节点，只是在控制流上回来了；只有当这段历史什么也没教会观察者时，它才在知识上回来。

In the project's native return model, a hidden depth k is shared by the whole process, and the next letter is alpha with chance F k plus one over F k plus three: one third, two fifths, three eighths, five thirteenths, closing in on one over phi squared.
在项目的原生返回模型里，一个隐藏深度 k 由整个过程共享，下一个字母是 alpha 的概率为 F(k+1) 除以 F(k+3)：三分之一、五分之二、八分之三、十三分之五，逐渐逼近 φ 平方的倒数。
Every letter actually read, including those in rejected or unfinished pairs, enters the posterior over depth.
每一个实际读到的字母，包括被拒绝或未完成配对中的字母，都进入关于深度的后验。
A return word, beta then alpha, has likelihood r times one minus r. After it, the predicted chance of alpha rises by a covariance over a mean, strictly, as long as two depths remain possible.
返回词「先 beta 后 alpha」的似然是 r 乘 1−r。读完它，预测下一个是 alpha 的概率上升，升幅等于一个协方差除以一个均值；只要还有两个深度可能，就严格上升。

With depths one and two at even odds, each return multiplies their relative weight by twenty-seven over twenty-five. The prediction starts at eleven thirtieths, rises by one over seven hundred eighty, and keeps climbing toward two fifths.
若深度一与深度二各占一半，每次返回都把它们的相对权重乘以二十五分之二十七。预测从三十分之十一出发，第一步上升七百八十分之一，并持续向五分之二攀升。

So the control point came back, but the true future did not. A predictor that wants to stay accurate must move its own prediction at least as far as the target moved, less its errors before and after.
所以控制点回来了，真实的未来却没有回来。想保持准确的预测器，必须把自己的预测至少移动目标移动的距离，再减去前后两次的误差。
Here the target moves by at least the rise in the alpha chance, so standing still is never exact.
在这里，目标至少移动了 alpha 概率的那段升幅，所以原地不动永远不会精确。
Repeat the return again and again. Every prediction in the sequence is different, so an observer that must be exactly right after each history needs a separate configuration for each one.
一次又一次地重复返回。序列中的每个预测都不相同，所以要在每段历史之后都精确无误的观察者，必须为每段历史准备一个单独的配置。
No finite set of configurations can do it. The bound is about exact prediction only; how well a finite observer can approximate is a different question.
任何有限的配置集都做不到。这个界只针对精确预测；有限观察者能近似到什么程度，是另一个问题。
In general, an update applies a nonnegative kernel to the law. A summary is sufficient exactly when the transposed kernel maps the kept functions back into themselves.
一般地，一次更新是对概率律施加一个非负核。当且仅当转置核把保留的函数映回它们自身，摘要才是充分的。
Close the space round by round. Five patterns close within five dimensions, but a shared depth with unbounded histories does not close in any finite one.
逐轮扩大这个空间直到闭合。五种模式在五维之内就闭合了，而共享深度加上无界的历史，在任何有限维里都不会闭合。
The same discipline holds for a qubit. The two states with Y equal to plus one and minus one give identical X and Z readings.
同样的纪律也适用于量子位。Y 取正一与负一的两个态，X 与 Z 的读数完全相同。
A quarter turn about Z sends Y to minus X, and the hidden difference appears. A classical kappa and a quantum phase are different objects, but neither can be dropped if a later step will read it.
绕 Z 转四分之一圈，把 Y 送到负 X，隐藏的差别便显现出来。经典的 kappa 与量子相位是不同的对象，但只要后续步骤会读到它，二者都不能被丢掉。
An observation is an update, and an update can read relations the summary had dropped. Return to the same node, and you may still know more than before.
观察就是一次更新，而更新会读到摘要已经丢掉的关系。回到同一个节点，你知道的可能已经比从前更多。

No frozen Lean declaration states these results for this model. The slices, the closure criteria, the four-corner tilt and the return predictions are argued in the theory volume, and every number here was recomputed for this film.
这一模型上的这些结论，目前没有对应的 Lean 冻结声明。条件切面、闭包判据、四角倾斜与返回预测在理论卷中论证，这里的每个数字都为这部片子重新计算过。
